ServerAddress_Comment: If you're running Bit.TemplatePlayground.Server.Web project, then you can also use relative urls such as / for Blazor Server and WebAssembly
ServerAddress_OAuth_Comment: OAuth: when you give an external app a public address to start authorization at, this address has to be public too - the consent page continues that same flow through it, so a localhost address here fails with invalid_target. A relative / ServerAddress is always safe.
AdUnitPath__Comment: The advertisement's unit path of the google ads from the Google Ad Manager panel.
